name: start-up-skills
description: The engineering know-how of the start-up factory, with the factory removed. 33 skills you invoke yourself, one at a time, when you decide you want them: .NET 10 Clean Architecture + DDD + CQRS backends (domain modeling, persistence, Minimal APIs, auth, testing, observability, performance, local dev, containers), feature-based React + TypeScript frontends (feature slices, state layers, component patterns, testing, scaffolding), React Native + Expo mobile apps for iOS and Android (scaffolding, navigation, auth, offline data, UI patterns, device capabilities, testing, EAS release), infrastructure (DigitalOcean, release pipelines), business (SaaS unit economics: cost per customer, AI/LLM token cost, tier capacity, the least subscription price that never runs at a loss), provider research, and process (grilling a plan into a spec, branch-and-PR discipline). No agents, no slash commands, no orchestration, no requirements pipeline — you drive, the skills only supply the patterns and templates. Ships the three architecture constitutions under docs/ so a project can carry the full rules the skills point at.
